contract: estimate_diffuse(train, test) -> dict {station: float array (n_targets,)} of 1-minute diffuse horizontal irradiance (W m-2, 0 to 1500) at the target minutes of each test station. train (Bondville, Desert Rock, Fort Peck, Goodwin Creek: bon, dra, fpk, gwn) and test (Penn State, Sioux Falls, Table Mountain: psu, sxf, tbl) map station codes to dicts with lat, lon, elevation_m and arrays over every daytime minute (solar zenith < 90 deg) of days 8, 23, ..., 353 of 2022 and 2023: day (days since 2022-01-01), minute (UTC minute of day), zen (solar zenith angle, deg), ghi (global horizontal irradiance), e0_horizontal (1361 (1 + 0.033 cos(2 pi doy/365)) cos(zen)), temp (deg C), rh (%), pres (hPa), NaN where SURFRAD's quality flag is not 0, and target_index (float indices of the scored minutes). train also holds dni (direct normal) and dhi (diffuse) irradiance; test does not. Measurements at any minute of a test day may be used. The candidate runs in a separate sandboxed process (numpy, scipy, scikit-learn and pandas importable; no file, network or subprocess access; one thread) with 180 s of CPU time for fitting and all predictions together; seed any randomness so that results are deterministic. Score: root-mean-square error (W m-2) over the 87316 test-station target minutes (zenith < 85 deg, GHI >= 10 W m-2, all three components flagged good and closing within max(20 W m-2, 8 percent of GHI)); lower is better. Missing stations, wrong shapes, NaN or values outside [0, 1500] are invalid
notes: Scores are recomputed from pinned public data prepared by scripts/prepare_earth.py; held-out data never enter the candidate's sandboxed process. The held-out observations are public, so a fixed candidate should be checked on later data before any scientific claim.
protocol_description: Locally implemented or adapted evaluator for the cited task or benchmark. Data sources, generated instances, evaluation budgets and protocol differences are specified in the candidate contract, requirements and notes; scores are not automatically comparable with published results.
name: Earth science: diffuse solar irradiance from global irradiance at unseen stations
description: Learn a separation model from 1-minute measurements of global, direct and diffuse solar irradiance at four NOAA SURFRAD stations and estimate the diffuse irradiance at three other stations from their global irradiance, solar geometry and meteorology on 48 days of 2022-2023. The score is the root-mean-square error of the estimated diffuse irradiance.
benchmark: Earth science: diffuse solar irradiance from global irradiance at unseen stations
paper_metric: Local protocol; see candidate contract and source adaptation notes

sources.locator: Erbs, Klein and Duffie (1982): diffuse fraction as a function of the clearness index, the classic separation model.
Ridley, Boland and Lauret (2010): logistic separation model with multiple predictors (the seed is its single-predictor form).
Yang (2022): review and worldwide comparison of 1-minute separation models, the evaluation setting followed here.
Augustine et al. (2000): the SURFRAD network and its measurements.
SURFRAD 1-minute daily files of seven stations, 48 days of 2022-2023 (public domain; retrieved 2026-10-11).

limitations: Only 48 sampled days per station (every 15th day of 2022 and 2023) are used, and the three test stations are mid-latitude continental U.S. sites; separation models behave differently in other climates.

The truth is the measured diffuse irradiance after quality control (flags, closure within 8 percent or 20 W m-2); measurement uncertainty of a few percent remains, and rejected minutes (often broken clouds or instrument issues) are not scored.
No clear-sky irradiance model or aerosol data are given; candidates must build any clear-sky reference themselves from the inputs.
A better score is a better separation model for these stations, not a scientific discovery; the data are public, so search feedback can overfit them.

The candidate runs in a sandboxed child process that never receives the test stations' direct or diffuse irradiance, and no statement of the candidate is executed in the evaluator's process; outside macOS (kernel sandbox) deliberately hostile native code could bypass the file policy.

state_of_the_art.statement: No published value exists for this station split and day sample. Internal references fitted on the training stations: median diffuse fraction in clearness-index bins 75.8 W m-2; the seed (logistic diffuse fraction in the clearness index) 77.2 W m-2 (normalised RMSE 47 percent of the mean diffuse irradiance).

sources.title: Estimating 1-min beam and diffuse irradiance from the global irradiance: A review and an extensive worldwide comparison of latest separation models at 126 stations

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Estimate the diffuse (and hence beam) component of solar irradiance from global irradiance measurements.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Global irradiance is measured or modelled far more widely than its components, but solar-energy yield on tilted or tracking surfaces, building energy and daylighting, and radiation climatology all need the diffuse and beam parts.
